title: IF unseen flag rate vs hybrid incremental rescue rate (Phase-2 closure; A1 precision)
wording: unseen / unknown anomaly simulation (NOT zero-day detection)
population_notes: The IF unseen flag rate and the hybrid incremental rescue rate use DIFFERENT populations. Population A (IF flag rate) = all temporally-unseen malicious flows (Bot + DDoS + PortScan, Friday test). Population B (rescue rate) = unseen malicious flows NOT already classified KNOWN_ATTACK by supervised inference. The rescue rate therefore sits below the IF flag rate by construction; the two numbers MUST NOT be compared as equivalent.
if_unseen_flag_rate_definition: fraction of ALL temporally-unseen malicious flows (population A) flagged by the anomaly detector on raw anomaly score < calibrated threshold (anomaly recall)

if_unseen_flag_rate_population.population: ALL unseen malicious flows (Bot + DDoS + PortScan)

note: aggregate IF flag rate/count are EXACT from unknown_experiment_temporal.json anomaly.metrics
hybrid_incremental_rescue_rate_definitio: among unseen malicious flows NOT already classified KNOWN_ATTACK by the supervised branch (population B), fraction surfaced to UNKNOWN_SUSPICIOUS by the IF anomaly branch of the hybrid

hybrid_incremental_rescue_aggregate.population: unseen malicious flows NOT classified KNOWN_ATTACK

estimate_consistency.note: The per-class estimated IF counts (sum above) are derived from rounded per-class percentages and may differ by a few rows from the EXACT aggregate count (metrics.true_positive). Use the aggregate exact count as authoritative; per-class counts are named estimated_if_flag_count.
